```markdown
## Context
Requesters export reports as CSV from the widgets app. The current p95 export latency is 5s for the representative 100-row report, measured in the recorded request-timing run. The requester supplied the 5s baseline and the 2s target; neither is an estimate.

## Problem
Requesters wait 5s at p95 for a 100-row CSV export instead of the required maximum of 2s.

source: none (not recorded at filing)

## Idea
The reporter proposes improving CSV export in acme/widgets.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] p95 request-to-file-ready latency for CSV exports of the representative 100-row report is <= 2s, measured with the same request-timing method as the recorded baseline (baseline 5s)

## Integration
- Non-blocking: monitor export latency after release.
- in staging (the environment where the p95 export latency criterion is measured)
```
